failing.summary: docs/how-to/install.md:489 (raised by opus as its dc-06): Claim: setup adds the PATH line to '`~/.zshrc` for zsh; for bash, `~/.bash_profile` on macOS and `~/.bashrc` on Linux'. Reality: zsh uses `${ZDOTDIR:-$HOME}/.zshrc`, and bash on macOS uses the first of `.bash_profile`, `.bash_login` and `.profile` that exists, creating `.bash_profile` only when none does (internal/core/shellpath/shellpath.go:20-29, 246-253). Setup names the file it edits, so nobody is misled into a wrong act. The file is unchanged in 1438645. Fix: '(`~/.zshrc`, or `$ZDOTDIR/.zshrc`, for zsh; for bash on macOS the first of `~/.bash_profile`, `~/.bash_login` and `~/.profile` that exists, and `~/.bashrc` on Linux)'. (also raised by the docs-currency review at docs/how-to/install.md:487-492, folded here as one finding)
